## Analysis of Advertisements on Instagram
This report explores advertisements on Instagram based on survey responses. The analysis focuses on the relationship between interest, ad clicked and the type of advertisement.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE)

```
## What's going on with this data?

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

csv_file <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTE1J98O8BrYPSwBP05_gRVywh-FguKoaHmzcLaglIsa6jpjU16WRb7Xe3b06hVYsCaluDLx4S6AhtR/pub?output=csv"

logged_data <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vTE1J98O8BrYPSwBP05_gRVywh-FguKoaHmzcLaglIsa6jpjU16WRb7Xe3b06hVYsCaluDLx4S6AhtR/pub?output=csv")

latest_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(ad_type = 'What type of advertisement did you see?',
         seconds = 'How many seconds did you watch the advertisement?',
         clicked = 'Did you click on the advertisement?',
         interest = 'How interesting did you find the advertisement? ( 1 = least interesting, 5 = most interesting)',
         frequency = 'How often have you seen similar advertisements today?')

# summary values
max(latest_data$seconds)
mean(latest_data$interest)

# bar charts

# bar charts for ad_type 
latest_data %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = ad_type),
           fill = "#B3F0FF") +
  labs(title = "types of adversitements",
       subtitle = "What kind of advertisements are on Instagram",
       caption = "Source: responses from the survey",
       x = "Ad type",
       y = "Count")


# bar charts for clicked and interest 
latest_data %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(y = interest, fill = clicked)) +
  labs(title = "More interest, more clicked?",
       subtitle = "Comparing interest and clicked for advertisemts on Instagram",
       caption = "Source: responses from the survey",
       x = "Interest (1 = least, 4 = most)",
       y = "Ad clicked")
```

* The maximum veiwing time on Instagram advertisements is `r max(latest_data$seconds)` seconds.

* The average interest level of the advertisements on Instagram is `r mean(latest_data$interest)`.
